# CAVE Clinic

> Natural-results aesthetics clinic in Manchester, UK, founded by Paris Tyrell. Known for The CAVE Secret™, a whole-face facial balancing method. Every treatment starts with a consultation (video £15, in person £30).

## Key facts
- Founder: Paris Tyrell, natural-results specialist.
- Team: Paris Tyrell (founder & aesthetic practitioner); Alix (skin specialist, facials and peels).
- Phone: 07534 455144. Email: Caveclinic@outlook.com. Instagram: @caveclinic.
- Booking: https://app.acuityscheduling.com/schedule/127a1ca6/
- Exclusive dates in London, Bradford, Liverpool and Ireland, announced on Instagram.

## Locations
- Main location: CAVE Clinic, 2nd Floor, Ivy Mill, Crown Street, Failsworth, Manchester M35 9BG. Open Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday.
- City centre: Glow Up Social, 34 John Dalton Street, Manchester M2 6LE. Open Wednesday and Sunday.

## Treatments and prices
- Consultations: Video consultation £15; In-person consultation £30
- Facial balancing: Tweak, 2ml £350; Refine, 3ml £450; Enhance, 4ml £550; Modify, 5ml £700; Transform (full plan) Consultation-led; The Mummy Makeover Consultation-led
- Lips & profile: Lips, 0.5ml £130; Lips, 0.7ml £180; Lips, 1ml £230; Cheeks, 1ml £300; Cheeks, 2ml £400; Chin £200; Jawline, 1ml £300; Jawline, 2ml £500; Nasolabial folds £300; Jowls £200; Non-surgical rhinoplasty £270; Tip lift £160; Dorsal hump £150; Review £30
- Skin boosters: Profhilo® £300; 10-point face lift (Profhilo®) £300; Under-eye brightening £150; Seventy Hyal £160; Anti-acne £175
- Skin & facials: The Fresh Glow £85; The Glass Skin Ritual £95; The Smooth Renewal £90; Exosome microneedling £125; The Clear Skin Peel £95; The Bright Peel £90; The Renew Peel £90; Microneedling £100; Derma rolling £150; Microneedling, course of 4 £300
- Body contouring: Under chin £100; Abdomen From £300; Legs, underarms or back From £200
- Wellbeing: Filler dissolving £110 per area; Vitamin injections Consultation-led
- Anti-wrinkle injections: consultation-led. A prescriber consultation is needed before your first treatment.
All treatments are subject to consultation. Results vary.
